_note: Magic item prices (Ashwin, 2026-10-14): Sane Magical Prices (Saidoro; layout SalmonSquire), the guide he picked, instead of the 2024 DMG's flat price by rarity, held since 2026-10-17 inside each rarity's band around the 2024 DMG's value (`bands`, `_bands_note`). `guide` is the guide transcribed from its five lists (name: gp, DMG 2014 page, rarity, list). `items` says how each item's cost_gp follows from it: `guide` names its row (`times` for a count: per dose, per lion); `like` names the closest row for an item the guide doesn't list (a 2024 rename, or the same kind of item: the +N spellcasting foci as the Rod of the Pact Keeper); `rule`: `median` is the guide's median for the item's rarity, consumables (its Consumables list) apart from the rest, and `book` keeps the 2024 DMG price for a common item that isn't a consumable (the guide prices none); `gp` is worked out as `why` says. An item built on a weapon or armor adds its base's cost (the guide: weapons and armor add the base's cost), as MagicItems.combine always has. `scrolls`: a Spell Scroll by its spell's level (MagicItems.SCROLL_PRICE). `excluded`: never sold (story items, artifacts, cursed or disguised items). What the guide won't price (`unpriced_by_the_guide`) is for sale too (Ashwin, 2026-10-15), priced as the other items it doesn't list: the closest row, the median, and a Potion of Giant Strength at a tenth of its Belt (the guide's rule for consumables). tools/data/magic_prices.py writes cost_gp from this; tests/unit/test_magic_shops.gd checks it.
source: Sane Magical Prices, Saidoro (Giant in the Playground, /r/DnDNext, EnWorld); Ashwin's copy, Sane_Magical_Prices.pdf
_bands_note: Rarity bands (Ashwin, 2026-10-17: some prices were insane, a 60,000 gp Handaxe of Warning for an uncommon item). The guide is checked against the 2024 DMG's value for each rarity (common 100, uncommon 400, rare 4,000, very rare 40,000, legendary 200,000 gp; a consumable half) and every price is held inside its rarity's band: nearer its own rarity's value than any other rarity's, so between the geometric means with the values either side (rounded). The guide still orders items inside a band. A consumable's band is half; ammunition, sold a piece at a time, is a consumable checked by the stack of ten it's found in (`ammunition_stack`). A weapon or armor's base still adds its own cost. `book` is a price a 2024 book prints (the PHB's Potion of Healing and its cantrip and level 1 Spell Scrolls), which wins over the guide and the bands. A Spell Scroll's price is its `scrolls` row held in the band for its rarity (MagicItems.SCROLL_RARITY), the same way. tools/data/magic_prices.py and tests/unit/test_magic_shops.gd both apply them.
